reference_note: The volume gives the night of 4 to 5 December 2015 as census reference night; enumeration ran from 5 to 18 December 2015.

source.title: 2015 Population and Housing Census: Summary of Final Results. Planning a Better Future
source.publisher: Statistics Sierra Leone (Stats SL), Freetown, December 2016

tables.Table 1: Distribution of total population by type of population, district and sex, printed page 28 (used for checking only)
tables.Table 2: Distribution of total population by region, district, sex and area of residence, printed page 30
tables.Table 3: Distribution of total population by region, district, chiefdom, area of residence and sex, printed pages 32 to 44

copy_read.form: a born-digital PDF (Adobe InDesign), 97 PDF pages, each a two-page spread; read with pdftotext -layout

transcription.by: read from the PDF's text layer (pdftotext -layout), not typed; the page images of printed pages 40 to 45 were viewed where a check failed
transcription.as_published: names as printed. The country row is the table's "Total country". Province and district names, and each chiefdom's parent, are Table 2's spellings; Table 3 prints the same districts in capitals and Bo as BO-SOUTH. Chiefdom names as Table 3 prints them, including Koidu/New, BKM and TMS.
transcription.corrections: none: the text layer read every number of Tables 1 to 3 cleanly, and every row it gave agrees with the page image where viewed

checks.men_plus_women_equals_total: 183 of 183 rows of counts.csv; also every row of Tables 1 and 3
checks.tables_agree: the country and the 14 districts are equal in Tables 1, 2 and 3; the 4 provinces are equal in Tables 2 and 3
checks.chiefdoms_sum_to_their_district: 12 of 14 districts. Fails, as printed (the page images show the same rows as the text layer, so this is the table, not the text layer): Bonthe, 11 chiefdoms printed, sum short of the district by 10075 (men 4925, women 5150), all of it in the urban columns; Pujehun, 11 chiefdoms printed, sum short by 13824 (men 6566, women 7258), all of it in the rural columns. Each district looks to lack one printed row; which unit it is the volume does not say, and no row has been added.

printed_errors_outside_the_columns_read: Table 3, printed page 44: in Western Area Urban and its eight areas, the urban Female column repeats the urban Male column (e.g. Western Area Urban 528207 and 528207, where the all-residence female is 527757). The page image shows the same. counts.csv reads the all-residence columns, which add up.

units: counts.csv: the country (Total country), its 4 provinces (Eastern, Northern, Southern, and Western, the Western Area), its 14 districts of 2015, and 164 units in Table 3's chiefdom position: chiefdoms, four cities (Kenema City, Koidu/New, Makeni City, Bo City), the 4 areas of Western Area Rural and the 8 of Western Area Urban. These are the units of 2015: Sierra Leone created two more districts in 2017 (16 now), so the 14 districts here are not today's. Fieldwork's Sierra Leone measles example uses the 2021 Mid-Term Census, not this one.

reviewed.found: First transcription. A Mid-Term Census followed in 2021; this folder does not hold it. Bonthe and Pujehun each lack one chiefdom row in Table 3 as printed.
